name: truemain-web
//browserslist: Kept modern enough that oklch/color-mix stay native (no rgb downlevel) — the `surface` material and the whole token layer are built on them. The Firefox target used to matter for a second reason too: it made Lightning CSS keep the unprefixed `backdrop-filter`, without which the blur collapsed to `-webkit-` only and Firefox rendered flat panels. #1060 removed the last translucent surface, so only the colour-function reason is live now.
